title: Connect a Telegram user session
goal: Authorize an existing Telegram account with a selected provider and verify the account identity without exposing login secrets in an agent chat.

evidence.scope: Telegram authentication and QR login are documented by Telegram. A private reference implementation was inspected, but a general AgentOS provider and a new end-to-end login were not verified.

prerequisites: An existing Telegram account in the official Telegram app.
A selected provider with its own Telegram API ID and API hash, or a trusted interface for entering application credentials in a self-hosted installation.
The user can identify the provider receiving session access and knows how to revoke it.

flows.when: The provider offers a trusted phone and code entry interface.

steps.action: Show the purpose of access, the exact provider, and the trusted login page. Do not request a login code in a bot or agent chat.
steps.proof: The user can identify the provider and the trusted login page.

steps.action: Enter the phone number on the trusted login page.
steps.proof: The provider accepts the number and requests a Telegram login code.

steps.action: Enter the Telegram login code and, if requested, the two-step verification password on the same trusted page.
Match the authorized Telegram account to the person requesting access; store the session in protected user storage.
steps.proof: A current identity and session-state receipt is available without exposing session contents.

flows.when: The user chooses QR login or phone-code login is unavailable.

steps.action: Create a time-limited QR login for the selected provider session.
steps.proof: The QR token is tied to the pending provider login.

steps.action: Scan and approve the login in the official Telegram app; complete two-step verification if Telegram requires it.
Match the authorized account and store the session in protected user storage.
steps.proof: A current identity and session-state receipt is available without exposing session contents.

recovery: Treat an expired or unconfirmed login as unsuccessful. Start a new request only after diagnosing the failure.
Do not store the session if the authorized account does not match the requester.
Explain how to revoke the Telegram device authorization and remove the local provider session.

review_triggers: provider or trusted login page change
